name: Ibarado Takushi
source:
Name: Takushi Ibarado
Sex: Male
Age: 54 (in [I]AI[/I]) | 55 (in [I]AINI[/I] Past) | 61 (in [I]AINI[/I] Present)
Birthday: November 23
Profession: Taxi driver
Likes: Ghosts, Doppelgänger, Fists, Saws, Chimneys
Dislikes: People who watch the map on their smartphones the whole ride ([I]AI[/I]) | Credit Card Transactions, Anything High-Tech, Smartphones ([I]AINI[/I])
Hobbies: Multi-level marketing
Skills: Tails, Sticking around, Keeping things casual ([I]AI[/I]) | Stalking, Stakeouts, Taking the Scenic Route ([I]AINI[/I])

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: The Somnium Files[/url][/i]:
He is a taxi driver, specializing in driving celebrities and entertainers. He has a special relationship with Lemniscate and often drives their talent.

In [i][url=/v31469]AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/I]:
A private taxi driver.
[Past]
Has an accent. Lemniscate regularly requests his services and he often gives rides to their talents. He's very knowledgeable about them.
[Present]
If necessary, he will take on transporter jobs. [spoiler]He knows Riichi Chieda from a while back, and when Riichi's personal driver got sick, he took over.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character descriptions]
